{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check if the biomarker values are plausible
print('Biomarker baseline - min/max:')
print(trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].agg(['min', 'max']))
print('\n')

print('Biomarker final - min/max:')
print(trial_df['biomarker_final'].agg(['min', 'max']))
print('\n')

# Check if the sentinel value -999.0 is used in both columns
print('Number of -999.0 in baseline:', (trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0).sum())
print('Number of -999.0 in final:', (trial_df['biomarker_final'] == -999.0).sum())
print('\n')

# Check if the sentinel value appears in both baseline and final for the same patient
same_sentinel = (trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0) & (trial_df['biomarker_final'] == -999.0)
print('Patients with -999.0 in both baseline and final:', same_sentinel.sum())"}
